ShadowedOrDuplicateAuthorship.doc: Warns about authorship records the composed prim can't report: an application shadowed by a stronger, explicit apiSchemas list, or an application authored in more than one prim spec, where composition keeps only the strongest opinion for each field.

AuthorshipInputsPaired.doc: inputs on an authorship record must hold (name, value) pairs: its length must be a multiple of the tuple-length given by its arraySizeConstraint.
